features: Exclusive AP or STA: saved-router failure restores AP, manual AP stays selected
Header switch changes the physical kit Wi-Fi mode before rediscovery
One USB pairing is remembered securely; each discovered reconnect asks Connect or Later
Enrollment failure and cooldown preserve scoped monitoring without repeated invalid proofs
A2-only Kit connection and flashing, with FlightCore 1.7.19 Bench on Auto Load and verified FlightCore 1.7.15 A2 rollback
Local AP/STA and USB Kit control; no TURN relay or internet physical Kit control in scope
Aerion A2 IMU XYZ calibration, automatic stored ESC controller result without tone ticks, Output Calibration and final Report; saved requests survive leaving the page
Output Calibration uses one acknowledged slider pump, a fresh startup lease and board-side calibration lease renewal; diagnostics retain Wizard saves, ESC results and request queue timing
App actions use on-page confirmations, inputs and status messages; connection settings open as a full page and Output Calibration retains its safety check
Aerof450 Quad X and Quad + PID profiles, unified Rate and Angle editor, and disarmed preview on supported A2 firmware
Setup Wizard Input Signal Configuration shows receiver and controller cards, source-specific settings, verified PPM mapping, and the saved input source on the connected A2.

Flight Data uses compact authenticated USB/AP/STA telemetry, fused roll/pitch animation, sample age and latency, and saved/active flight mode. Setup Wizard guides ACC / Gyro calibration through stationary gyro bias, six verified accelerometer poses, and a separate Level Horizon save.

Firmware Flash can explicitly load the verified A2 1.7.22 Experimental Acro + Angle APP or Factory image, with corrected flight scheduler deadline tracking. Physical acceptance for this build is NOT_RUN.

Live Inputs shares one authenticated RC reader with the Kit header. PPM receiver loss, waiting for signal and delayed observations have separate states. Flight Data shows the reported failsafe reason.
Header FC Kits lists remembered and detected A2 profiles. Explicit Connect rechecks the selected Device ID with a fast saved IP probe and bounded alias fallback.
Setup report downloads request fresh read-only Flight Readiness when needed and include the reported ARM or failsafe reason.
